emails.verification.subject: Verify your Dayline email
emails.verification.description: Confirm your email address using this link. It expires in 24 hours.
emails.binding.subject: Confirm your Dayline email address
emails.binding.description: This link only verifies your email address. It does not sign you in or move any account. Continue on the original device within 30 minutes.
emails.reset.subject: Reset your Dayline password
emails.reset.description: If you did not request a password reset, you can ignore this email. This link expires in 30 minutes.
emails.footer: This link expires. Please do not forward it.
